exam_scheme.note: Conducted biannually (June and November sessions) by the Himachal Pradesh Board of School Education (HPBOSE), Dharamshala, on behalf of the Department of School Education, Government of Himachal Pradesh, in compliance with Section 23(1) of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009, and National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) norms. The test covers 10 distinct teaching subject categories: JBT (D.El.Ed.), TGT Arts, TGT Non-Medical, TGT Medical, TGT Hindi, TGT Sanskrit (Shastri), Punjabi Language Teacher, Urdu Language Teacher, Special Educator (Pre-Primary to Class V), and Special Educator (Classes VI to XII). Each test paper comprises 150 objective multiple-choice questions (MCQs) carrying 1 mark each (total 150 marks), with a duration of 150 minutes (2 hours 30 minutes). The examination is bilingual in English and Hindi (except language-specific sections). There is no negative marking. Qualifying standard is 60% (90 marks out of 150) for Unreserved candidates, and 55% (82 marks out of 150) with a 5% relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, and Physically Handicapped (PHH) candidates of Himachal Pradesh. TET qualification certificates carry lifetime validity.

competition_benchmarks.note: Statistics verified directly from official result declarations and statistical press releases issued by the Departmental Examination Branch (DEB), Himachal Pradesh Board of School Education (HPBOSE), Dharamshala. Passing the HPTET is a mandatory statutory prerequisite under Section 23 of the RTE Act, 2009 for appointment as JBT, TGT, Shastri, Language Teacher, and Special Educator in elementary and secondary schools under the Himachal Pradesh Department of School Education.
